subject: Re: POC Trial - Model selection & evaluation plan
thread_summary: Post-call recap and alignment on POC success criteria, evaluation plan, timelines, and model selection. Primary model: Llama 2 13B (open model); fallback: Llama 2 7B for cost-sensitive paths. Multilingual handling: test locale performance and consider auxiliary translation/MT for non-English prompts. Ownership: Jordan (sales) to own contract/exec signoff, Marissa (CSM) to run POC orchestration, Ben (SE) to run model evals and infra verification.
success_criteria: Quality: >=4/5 average on 50 evaluation prompts (accuracy, helpfulness, low hallucination). Performance: p95 latency <300ms for interactive flows (sample load), stable throughput for 2k concurrent daily active users. Cost: estimated unit cost within target (TBD) and less than current vendor baseline. Security: no unacceptable data leakage in sample prompts; SOC2 evidence acceptable.
evaluation_plan: 1) Ben will run 50 evaluation prompts (provided in eval_prompts.csv) across candidate models and collect automated metrics (exact-match, hallucination flags) and human scores. 2) Run 3 workload scenarios (light, medium, peak) to capture latency distributions. 3) Validate multilingual responses for ES/FR/DE with 20 prompts each. 4) Produce a short report (benchmarks + recommendations) within 7 business days after POC kickoff.
next_steps:
- Jordan: send mutual action plan and DocuSign by 2026-02-19.
- Acme (Sofia/Liam): confirm signed MPA + sample data access by 2026-02-24.
- Ben: initial model benchmarks and infra checklist by 2026-02-25.
- Marissa: schedule weekly check-ins (first check-in 2026-02-26).
- Joint: decision on primary model and fallback by end of POC week 2.
